thread:
marta_finance: Flagging invoice INV-2026-04-01 for BetaCorp - shows 12,000,000 embedding units for March 14. Our ledger shows 1,200,000. Suspect export multiplier bug or duplicate export.
diego_billing: I'll pull the export CSVs and backfill logs.
billing-bot: export-job #export-20260401 finished 2026-04-01T04:10:00Z; backfill-job #bfill-emb-20260314 ran 2026-03-14T02:00:00Z
sam_backfill: Metering DB query: SUM(embedding_units) = 1,200,000 for that customer and window. No duplicate rows.
diego_billing: Exporter CSV shows 12000000. Looks like a x10. Checking deploy history for exporter service.
diego_billing: Deploy at 2026-04-01T03:55 had config change `export.multiplier=10` mistakenly set.
marta_finance: Ok root cause found. Action: void invoice, issue corrected invoice and credit memo, and scan invoices from that deploy window. Liz, please hold customer comms until we reissue.
liz_sales: On it. Draft: "We discovered an internal billing export issue that overstated embedding usage by 10x for Mar 14. We've issued a corrected invoice and credit; apologies for the confusion."
diego_billing: I will re-run re-export dry-run: `billing export reprocess --customer betacorp --start 2026-03-14 --end 2026-03-15 --dry-run` -> 1,200,000 units. I'll also add a CI check to reject non-1 multipliers.
marta_finance: Kevin (CFO) approved one-off credits up to $10k for customer experience; exceeding that needs his sign-off.
liz_sales: Customer acknowledged: "Thanks for the quick correction." :thumbsup:
